purpose.zh: 练手臂举过头时肩胛上旋
purpose.en: Train the shoulder blades to rotate up as your arms go overhead.

text.zh: 前臂贴住泡沫轴，推墙向上滚
text.en: Press your forearms into the roller and roll it up the wall

text.zh: 面向墙站直，前臂平行，掌心相对
text.en: Stand tall facing the wall with forearms parallel, palms facing.

text.zh: 最高处肩胛向前送，停2秒再滑下
text.en: At the top, reach your shoulder blades forward, hold for two seconds, then slide down.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减小上滑幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Slide up less if your shoulders hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
